known_limitations: Target GPU execution is required to produce official performance results.
WMMA Tensor Core path requires M, N, and K divisible by 16.
Vectorized float4 path requires N divisible by 4.
CPU reference verification is intentionally blocked for extremely large FLOP counts; use --no-verify for those performance runs.
Nsight Compute/System availability is environment-dependent under WSL2. Any attach or permission failure is recorded rather than fabricated.
open_investigations: Measure the clean baseline and full workload matrix on the target RTX 4060 Laptop GPU.
Profile winning and regressing kernels with Nsight Compute where attachment is possible.
Use measured register usage, occupancy, memory throughput, and instruction metrics to accept or reject targeted variants.
Populate optimization_log.md and final_report.md only from recorded experiments.
